description: Full-text search across 320+ Onramp Media podcast transcripts (The Last Trade, Final Settlement and others) for what a guest or host said about a topic. Returns episode, show, date, matching passages and the episode URL. Use for 'what did X say about Y' and for sourcing a quote. Transcripts are machine-generated; verify a quote against the audio before publishing it.

query.description: Word or phrase to search for, e.g. 'multisig', 'Mt. Gox', 'custody insurance'.

show.description: Optional show name filter, e.g. 'The Last Trade'.

name: search_transcripts
